cm10/campaign-pricing reuse uncertain noninterruptible demand-to-PAYG reasoning

findings.limit: Qualitative risk sample; no prevalence or learner-effect estimate.

sealedBlindAnswers.review: PR42 independent pre-key blind assessment review
sealedBlindAnswers.exposure_declaration: Before this seal I read only blind-sample-final.json and did not read keys, rubrics, feedback, prior reviews, source, guides or manuscript. The blind judgments use packet text and general subject knowledge. No actual browser rendering inspected.

scope.population_inference_limit: Risk-selected sample only; not a random estimate of all-bank defect prevalence and not psychometric validation.

paired_reviews.rationale: The indispensable Linux guest-kernel driver, kernel-version choice and reboot control require the guest OS boundary of a VM; container repackaging does not remove that requirement.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Windows Hyper-V isolation is not a substitute for the required Linux guest.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: The necessary control boundary is stated very explicitly; near application of service-control concepts.

paired_reviews.rationale: Accepted A explains vm-old and its exact dependent IDs. Rejected B with no additions and unchanged revision cannot be credited with a new VM or with A's older resources.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: The local deterministic receipt premise makes eventual Azure deployment an invalid alternative.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Meaningful command/outcome/resource attribution; wording itself rules out asynchronous ambiguity.

paired_reviews.rationale: Management grouping does not change network topology: inspect the NIC/subnet/VNet chain and establish a supported connection.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: No peering or other existing path is given. A subscription or metadata location cannot provide one.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Good boundary distinction, but both distractors conflate visibly different concepts.

paired_reviews.rationale: The stipulated failure is missing application authorization after valid resolution and routing, so inspect the app role.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: DNS and subnet changes do not address the expressly identified failure.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Recognition is heavily scaffolded: the stem supplies the root cause.

paired_reviews.rationale: A site-to-site IPsec/IKE VPN uses the branch device as the network tunnel peer over the allowed internet underlay.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: An individual P2S client does not document the branch network connection. A physical branch router is not an Azure VNet for peering.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Conventional service-to-requirement matching with explicit constraints; near application.

paired_reviews.rationale: Private Endpoint approval applies to the supported target subresource, so File needs its proper endpoint and DNS design rather than repurposing Blob.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Existing private NIC lifecycle and common account ownership are true context but do not extend subresource scope.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Good subresource boundary, though RG distractor is easy to reject.

paired_reviews.rationale: The unmodified two-client SMB/open/lock contract matches Azure Files SMB, subject to support, network and permissions.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Blob object names are not SMB semantics and a managed disk is not automatically a shared file service.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Repeated SMB contract language makes matching straightforward.

paired_reviews.rationale: Two ordinary independent block volumes do not synchronize content; use the SMB file service expected by both applications.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: A deliberately engineered shared-disk cluster is expressly outside scope. Table entities cannot supply SMB operations.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: This is a close sibling of sa02, so repeated exposure would not establish fresh transfer.

paired_reviews.rationale: Copy rehydration can preserve the archived source at day 70 without early-exiting its tier; wait for the new online copy to complete and account for its own costs.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Destination-name appearance is not rehydration completion. Changing the original violates preservation and the minimum-period concern.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Combines archival economics and readiness evidence; less rote than simple tier naming.

paired_reviews.rationale: Use supported ZRS separately for Files and the data disk, then plan usable compute and disk attachment; the protected data does not restart a zonal VM.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: RA/geo properties do not apply generically to all storage services; preserving a disk does not preserve the guest running state.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Useful cross-service/application-boundary application with explicit support assumptions.

paired_reviews.rationale: Fetch each needed file in full while connected, verify completion and test offline access; namespace, a first page and a partial cache do not prove whole-file offline readiness.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Disabling tiering is not evidence that previously tiered file content has been fully recalled.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Plausible partial-content alternatives require attention to the actual offline contract.

paired_reviews.rationale: Azure File Sync with cloud tiering serves the temporary two-server namespace/cache requirement. After writes stop, either a bounded supported copy or one-way sync without destination deletions can carry the chosen set while preserving unrelated targets.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Both decision 2 and decision 3 are technically valid under the explicit support, writer-stop and newer-source assumptions. Neither extends a server sync relationship.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Important deliberate non-single-key case. Elaborate premises neutralize metadata/direction objections; task asks differentiated mechanisms rather than mere names.

paired_reviews.rationale: Entra Domain Services does not permit the required AD DS schema extension; customer-run AD DS violates the Microsoft-operated-DC constraint. Renegotiate a requirement.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: An OU does not confer schema control and hosting AD DS in Azure does not transfer domain operations to Microsoft.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Strong no-feasible-choice reasoning under the stated option set, with an explicit constraint pair.

paired_reviews.rationale: For the home user reaching the resource organization's shared channel via direct connect, resource inbound plus home outbound must allow it.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Home inbound is the reverse direction; switching to a B2B guest/standard channel breaks the required experience.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Useful directional application, but the inbound/outbound pairing can also be memorized.

paired_reviews.rationale: Contributor is already sufficient for the operation. Apply the resource tag required by Policy; Owner does not bypass a deny, and group tags are not automatically inherited.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: The paired accepted/rejected requests isolate configuration from role/scope/login changes.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Controlled comparison supports causal reasoning, although the stem expressly identifies the deny rule.

paired_reviews.rationale: Split Block scope along both identity and application: employees remain blocked to both apps, partners to finance; preserve partner/project MFA.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: App exclusion opens project for employees; partner exclusion opens finance for partners. A grant cannot override a remaining Block match.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: One of the stronger matrix tasks; each plausible broad exception fails a different cell.

paired_reviews.rationale: The device signal must describe device B making the request, and export authorization belongs to the application data action; management Reader on the RG cannot establish that permission.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: A valid user session does not transfer A's device facts to B. Reading resource management metadata is not exporting application data.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Good two-boundary evidence/authorization combination. Correct reason is more explicit and somewhat longer than alternatives in packet text; actual visible rendering still requires inspection.

paired_reviews.rationale: Have each person perform and verify their own stream: StorageC configuration remediation and ServerB activity investigation. ServerA maintenance is not evidence that ServerB's alert is benign.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Both the parallel verification-first wording and the ServerB-first-with-simultaneous-StorageC-owner wording satisfy the requested parallel plan.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Strong evidence attribution with valid alternate plan wording. Correct reason synthesizes two tasks; do not infer visible length from character count alone.

paired_reviews.rationale: Compare the complete mix of relevant meters, rates, quantities and terms, including unresolved region, traffic, license and support costs.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Resource count and compute-only totals do not price different storage/compute mixes.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Good total-cost boundary, but the completeness wording makes the right option conspicuous.

paired_reviews.rationale: The verified sufficient PAYG profile avoids Spot interruption and unjustified long commitments while usage is gathered; pricing alone does not prove HA.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: The work cannot resume after interruption and no stable commitment baseline exists.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Close conceptual overlap with campaign-pricing; new noun context is limited transfer.

paired_reviews.rationale: Curate data products with responsible owners and scoped glossary terms so both retained source definitions can be discovered without merging data.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Collections/access rights and ARM tags do not define the business meaning; classifications do not adjudicate the two meanings.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Relevant semantic governance task; product terminology may dominate over deeper performance.

paired_reviews.rationale: CanNotDelete protects resource deletion while allowing needed management updates; logical data deletion requires a separately suitable tested historical recovery mechanism.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Reason 2 (ReadOnly is more intrusive) and reason 3 (replication has limited physical-protection roles) are true in isolation, but neither justifies both parts of the selected plan. They are partial truths, not accepted equivalent explanations.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Useful management/data plane distinction; potential learner concern is rejection of true-but-incomplete reasons unless feedback states the completeness criterion.

paired_reviews.rationale: Use existing operation/Properties evidence for management configuration and require a separate successful user-function test.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: An exportable template can be true/useful documentation but not proof of the failed user function; resource existence/URL likewise cannot establish it.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Good evidence-scope separation, with a true-but-insufficient reason distractor.

paired_reviews.rationale: Fix serverFarmId to the approved plan's full existing resource ID. dependsOn does not create an absent referent and changing CLI context cannot rewrite an explicit incorrect ID.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: The full-ID description in reason 1 is true but does not by itself explain why dependsOn/context fail to repair the reference.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Concrete ARM reference application; full-ID terminology echoed between the correct choice and reason is a possible matching cue.

paired_reviews.rationale: Map exposed administrative surface to Security, a vulnerable single point to Reliability, and reviewed rollout practice to Operational Excellence; these are recommendations without confirmed incident evidence.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: A continuity single point is not primarily Performance here, and rollout procedure is not itself a performance categorization.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Mostly category recognition. Nearly parallel decisions reduce voice cues but repeated correct taxonomy exposure can teach labels rather than diagnosis.

paired_reviews.rationale: Validate relevant collected sources and app coverage, then configure a log-query alert evaluation and action group to detect the exact pattern automatically all day.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Manual shift searches cannot satisfy automatic continuous evaluation; CPU metrics do not substitute for the stipulated log pattern. True general metric/manual-query reasons are insufficient.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: The appended all-day automation requirement resolves a plausible manual-review alternative; answer still reads as the only complete workflow.

paired_reviews.rationale: PAYG fits six weeks of uncertain use without an unjustified long commitment; Spot-only compute conflicts with non-interruptible orders.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: Storage/other charges persist; no numerical cost ranking can be derived.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Near application of the same price/interruptibility principle as cm10; a new story alone is not evidence of far transfer.

paired_reviews.rationale: Both supported App Service and VM are valid: PaaS transfers platform OS maintenance but retains customer code/data/access duties; IaaS additionally requires team guest-OS operations.
paired_reviews.alternatives_or_ambiguity: The premises intentionally give no minimal-operations or full-control preference. Accept either coherent decision/reason pair, not cross-paired responsibility explanations.
paired_reviews.cue_and_transfer_assessment: Strong anti-overclaim example: multiple defensible services are explicit. Tests calibrated responsibility rather than one-product reflex.

legacy_reviews.rationale_and_quality: All ten selections follow the stated failure/geographic/sovereign constraints. Distributed API without zonally resilient data leaves a required dependency exposed. Different buildings in one zone do not defeat the zone-wide fault. Logical zone numbers do not prove physical mapping. Region pairs neither constrain all app-region choices nor instantiate recovery. Mostly concept and taxonomy recognition; the integrated dependency question is stronger.
legacy_reviews.valid_alternatives: None under the stated premises; no hidden price ranking or service support assumed.

legacy_reviews.rationale_and_quality: Two surviving instances supply 6 against demand 7, so unmet=1. Other fields reject broad automatic claims. All five selectable answers appear first in this packet; if rendered unchanged this offers a serious within-form position cue. The wrong alternatives are conspicuously absolute (all/automatic/nothing/only) and the right alternatives qualified. Numeric input has no option-position cue.
legacy_reviews.valid_alternatives: None under the stated premises; no hidden price ranking or service support assumed.

legacy_reviews.rationale_and_quality: The short event code suits Functions subject to plan/latency assessment; the kernel driver needs VM guest control. Real successful output, customer code/data/access duties, and plan/allocation/services determine the other judgments. Several distractors use never/always/all/free, so recognition by tone is a material concern. This is the same kernel/control boundary as cp01 in another context.
legacy_reviews.valid_alternatives: None under the stated premises; no hidden price ranking or service support assumed.

legacy_reviews.rationale_and_quality: Max demand 7 minus allocation 5 gives 2 shortfall. Demand is below allocation in hours 1,3,4. Provider purchase alone changes neither demand nor allocation; cloud/virtualization retain finite hardware and customer duties. Private cloud can be third-party hosted; integration with public and retained on-prem is hybrid. Idle allocated compute can cost money; uncertain noninterruptible demand favors PAYG. Eight of ten selectable answers appear second and several distractors are absolute caricatures; actual rendered order requires checking. Numeric field excluded from option-position analysis.
legacy_reviews.valid_alternatives: None under the stated premises; no hidden price ranking or service support assumed.

strengths: No apparent factual-key ambiguity in the single-answer sampled cases under their explicit premises.
Three cases deliberately admit alternate coherent pairs: fm10, sp08, two-valid-hosts.
Several richer tasks require evidence attribution, conjunctive policy scope, or separation of management/data/runtime responsibilities.
risks: Possible all-first position cue in legacy benefits and dominant-second cue in foundations-v2 if options render unchanged.
Many wrong options assert automatic/all/always behavior while the right one is qualified and complete; this can reward test-taking tone recognition.
True-but-insufficient reason distractors in gc09, mt02 and mt10 need feedback explaining the relevant completeness criterion.
New titles and industries do not alone establish transfer: storage sa02/sa12 and pricing cm10/campaign-pricing are close conceptual repetitions.
Separate decision/reason fields can disclose the decision through answer-to-reason matching; later browser/source comparison must check feedback and exposure gates.
blind_synthesis.validation_limit: No learner study, reliability, discrimination, difficulty, retention or transfer evidence established. Distinguish text plausibility from actual learner performance.
